You're in control

Not available that day? Just block it.

Going on leave or have a long procedure? Add a row to your Availability sheet. The booking form updates by itself — customers simply can't pick the dates or times you've blocked.

  • No manual typing

    Every answer your customer gives lands in its own column — name, phone, service, date and time.

  • Organized, instant records

    Each booking gets its own ID and timestamp, so nothing gets lost in messages or notebooks.

  • Track every status

    Update each booking's status from a simple dropdown, starting as Pending.

  • Only open dates & times

    Customers choose from available dates and time slots, which helps you avoid double bookings.
